label: Area
definition: FAOSTAT name of the reporting geographic area
allowed_values: Botswana; Eswatini; Lesotho; Malawi; Mozambique; Namibia; South Africa; Zambia; Zimbabwe
notes: The teaching extract omits provider area codes; use codes rather than labels when integrating other sources.

label: Item
definition: FAOSTAT agricultural commodity represented by the observation
notes: The teaching extract contains one item.

label: Element
definition: FAOSTAT measure recorded by the value field
notes: Interpret together with unit and value.

label: Year
definition: Calendar year to which the annual observation refers
notes: The tracked teaching extract has fixed 1990-2022 coverage.

label: Unit
definition: Measurement unit associated with the element and value
allowed_values: ha for Area harvested; t for Production; kg/ha for Yield
notes: Do not compare or combine values without checking their element and unit.

label: Value
definition: Numeric quantity reported for the associated area item element year and unit
missing_values: blank represents missing and is not zero
notes: Precision and estimation method depend on the source observation and flag.

label: Flag
definition: FAOSTAT status describing the origin or treatment of the reported value
